notes: Official script/mipnerf360.py trains with -r 4 (outdoor) / -r 2 (indoor) = PIL resize of full-res images -> mipnerf360-pilr protocol. Per-scene PSNR from supp. Table 7 (360scene_compare.tex). Bicycle = outdoor (paper Table 1 challenging scene), bonsai = indoor with the largest reported gain. Primary comparison: gain over the pilr gsplat baseline vs paper gain over 3DGS*. Expect ~1.3-1.7x baseline Gaussians and memory (paper Table 4: 1.2 GB vs 0.72 GB); bicycle may reach ~8-10M Gaussians -> --min-free-gb 20. First job JIT-compiles the small CUDA kernel (~1 min, cached). Optional ablations: pixel-gs-pixel-only, pixel-gs-depth-only.
